sections.text:
Ability Power 210. Damages all enemies with physical time-elemental damage.
Ability Power boosted by 10 for each increase in Skill level.
-Stuns all enemies with a success value of 40.
-Reduces action speed of all enemies for 40 seconds (affects CPU targets such as enemy monsters).
-Reduces Cost recovery speed of all enemies for 40 seconds.
-Restores your own character's Cost by 13.
[Additional Unison Effect] Increases fire, water, wind, light, and, dark elemental attack for all allies by 2 for 60 seconds
Increases stats selected in stat slot 2 by 1000
Increases stats selected in stat slot 2 by 1000
[Unison Effect Boost] Applies Cost recovery effect to all allies.
Increases stats selected in stat slot 1 by 2000
Only [Big Boss] Darius can be used as Unlocking Potential material
